root.title: Canonical productive-planning cutover
root.objective: Plan the daemon-owned cutover to canonical planning, deterministic verification and direct compilation while retiring legacy reachability and preserving regression gates.

outcomes.description: The daemon composes the canonical planner, verifier and direct compiler as the only productive planning route.
RecursivePlanner, WorkBreakdown projection and the legacy graph compiler are unreachable from productive planning entrypoints.
Daemon lifecycle ownership, repository grounding and existing gates remain green after cutover.

cut.criterion: Separate independently verifiable daemon, planning engine, verifier, direct compiler, legacy-retirement and regression-gate responsibilities.
cut.rationale: The supplied evidence locates six distinct ownership surfaces joined by explicit SemanticPlan and GraphRevision seams.

children.title: Daemon planning composition
children.objective: Compose the canonical productive planning route inside the daemon lifecycle boundary using the exact repository view.

outcomes.description: The daemon adapter supplies canonical planning inputs and retains lifecycle adoption authority.

children.title: Canonical PlanningEngine
children.objective: Produce the sole canonical SemanticPlan from the registered goal and exact repository evidence.

outcomes.description: The PlanningEngine produces canonical SemanticPlan material without a parallel productive representation.

children.title: Deterministic SemanticPlan verifier
children.objective: Deterministically verify canonical SemanticPlan structure, refinements, ownership, artifacts and seams before compilation.

outcomes.description: Canonical SemanticPlan input is deterministically accepted or rejected with attributable findings before compilation.

children.title: Direct SemanticPlan compiler
children.objective: Compile verified SemanticPlan material directly into canonical GraphRevision material.

outcomes.description: The compiler transforms SemanticPlan directly into GraphRevision with canonical artifact, seam and resource relations.

children.title: Legacy planning retirement
children.objective: Remove productive reachability of RecursivePlanner, WorkBreakdown projection and the legacy compiler route.

outcomes.description: A protected static scan detects no legacy planner, WorkBreakdown projection or legacy compiler reachable from productive planning.

children.title: Regression gate preservation
children.objective: Preserve canonical graph validation and run the registered prior lifecycle and repository-grounding gates against the cutover candidate.

outcomes.description: Prior lifecycle, repository-grounding and canonical-graph gates cover the exact integrated cutover candidate.

seams.purpose: Carry the immutable goal and exact repository view from the daemon lifecycle owner into canonical planning.

interface.promise: Canonical planning receives the registered GoalContract and RepositoryView while lifecycle ownership remains in the daemon.
interface.compatibility: Exact goal revision, digest, repository-view digest and treeSha are required.

seams.purpose: Expose SemanticPlan as the sole productive planning representation for verification and direct compilation.

interface.promise: The PlanningEngine emits canonical SemanticPlan material bound to the exact goal and repository view.
interface.compatibility: Consumers accept the exact canonical SemanticPlan contract without a WorkBreakdown projection.

seams.purpose: Gate direct compilation with deterministic, attributable SemanticPlan verification.

interface.promise: The compiler receives an identity-bound verification result for its exact SemanticPlan input.
interface.compatibility: Required verification findings block compilation and preserve typed attribution.

seams.purpose: Provide the canonical GraphRevision candidate to regression validation and root integration.

interface.promise: Direct compilation yields GraphRevision material tied to the source SemanticPlan and exact RepositoryView.
interface.compatibility: Canonical artifact, seam, resource and contract relations must validate exactly.

seams.purpose: Supply protected static reachability evidence for legacy retirement.

interface.promise: Productive daemon entrypoints contain no reachable legacy planning or projection route.
interface.compatibility: The protected negative control must detect reintroduction of a legacy productive reference.

seams.purpose: Supply prior-gate evidence for the exact integrated cutover candidate.

interface.promise: Regression evidence identifies the candidate and covers daemon lifecycle ownership, repository grounding and canonical graph validation.
interface.compatibility: Evidence from a different candidate or repository view is not interchangeable.
